name: vertx-http
title: Vert.x HTTP Client
description: Send requests to external HTTP servers using Vert.x
label: http

properties.name: httpUri
properties.description: The HTTP URI to connect to

properties.name: bridgeEndpoint
properties.label: producer
properties.description: If the option is true, the Exchange.HTTP_URI header will be ignored and the endpoint URI will be used for the HTTP request. You may also set option throwExceptionOnFailure to false to return the fault response back to the client.

properties.name: connectTimeout
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The amount of time in milliseconds until a connection is established. A timeout value of zero is interpreted as an infinite timeout.

properties.name: cookieStore
properties.label: producer
properties.description: A custom CookieStore to use when session management is enabled. If this option is not set then an in-memory CookieStore is used

properties.name: headerFilterStrategy
properties.label: producer
properties.description: A custom org.apache.camel.spi.HeaderFilterStrategy to filter header to and from Camel message.

properties.name: httpMethod
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The HTTP method to use. The HttpMethod header cannot override this option if set

properties.name: multipartUpload
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Whether to force using multipart/form-data for easy file uploads. This is only to be used for uploading the message body as a single entity form-data. For uploading multiple entries then use io.vertx.ext.web.multipart.MultipartForm to build the form.

properties.name: multipartUploadName
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The name of the multipart/form-data when multipartUpload is enabled.

properties.name: okStatusCodeRange
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The status codes which are considered a success response. The values are inclusive. Multiple ranges can be defined, separated by comma, e.g. 200-204,209,301-304. Each range must be a single number or from-to with the dash included

properties.name: responsePayloadAsByteArray
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Whether the response body should be byte or as io.vertx.core.buffer.Buffer

properties.name: sessionManagement
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Enables session management via WebClientSession. By default the client is configured to use an in-memory CookieStore. The cookieStore option can be used to override this

properties.name: throwExceptionOnFailure
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Disable throwing HttpOperationFailedException in case of failed responses from the remote server

properties.name: timeout
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The amount of time in milliseconds after which if the request does not return any data within the timeout period a TimeoutException fails the request. Setting zero or a negative value disables the timeout.

properties.name: tracingPolicy
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The tracing policy used by the HTTP client when integrating with observability frameworks such as OpenTelemetry. If not specified the HTTP client applies a default tracing policy of PROPAGATE.

properties.name: transferException
properties.label: producer
properties.description: If enabled and an Exchange failed processing on the consumer side, and if the caused Exception was sent back serialized in the response as a application/x-java-serialized-object content type. On the producer side the exception will be deserialized and thrown as is, instead of HttpOperationFailedException. The caused exception is required to be serialized. This is by default turned off. If you enable this then be aware that Camel will deserialize the incoming data from the request to a Java object, which can be a potential security risk.

properties.name: useCompression
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Set whether compression is enabled to handled compressed (E.g gzipped) responses

properties.name: vertxHttpBinding
properties.label: producer
properties.description: A custom VertxHttpBinding which can control how to bind between Vert.x and Camel.

properties.name: webClientOptions
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Sets customized options for configuring the Vert.x WebClient

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: proxyHost
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: The proxy server host address

properties.name: proxyPassword
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: The proxy server password if authentication is required

properties.name: proxyPort
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: The proxy server port

properties.name: proxyType
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: The proxy server type

properties.name: proxyUsername
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: The proxy server username if authentication is required

properties.name: basicAuthPassword
properties.label: security
properties.description: The password to use for basic authentication

properties.name: basicAuthUsername
properties.label: security
properties.description: The user name to use for basic authentication

properties.name: bearerToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: The bearer token to use for bearer token authentication

properties.name: deserializationFilter
properties.label: advanced,security
properties.description: Sets an ObjectInputFilter pattern (jdk.serialFilter syntax) applied when deserializing Java objects from HTTP responses with Content-Type application/x-java-serialized-object. This is used when transferException is enabled (or when allowJavaSerializedObject is enabled on the component) and the remote side returns a serialized payload. When not set, the filter configured via the JVM system property jdk.serialFilter is used when present; otherwise a conservative default filter denying java.net. and otherwise allowing java., javax. and org.apache.camel. packages is applied.

properties.name: sslContextParameters
properties.label: security
properties.description: To configure security using SSLContextParameters
